title: Fit ranking quality
notes: In-process over the synthetic cohort — no database. Calls the real ranker (rankLeadFits in src/lib/connect/matching-shared.ts), which is also what rankLeadsForStudent calls, so the benchmark cannot drift from the ranking students get. Labels are an INDEPENDENT judgement rule, not the score: see scripts/bench/generate-matching-labels.mjs. Owner step: one SPOKES instructor audits 200 of the 2,000 pairs (design §9 decision 2) before this floor is treated as authoritative.
